access_rules.description: List of access control rules, in order. Each rule specifies an action ('allow' or 'deny') and an IP or CIDR range.

action.description: Whether to permit or block traffic from the entity.

bind_address.description: IP address and port the server will bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1:8080').

cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds for caching static files (0 disables caching).

compression.description: If true, compress text-based responses using gzip or brotli where supported by the client.

custom_headers.description: Map of HTTP header names (e.g., 'X-Frame-Options') to values (e.g., 'SAMEORIGIN').

directory_listing.description: If true, display a directory index when accessing a directory; if false, return 404.

index_files.description: List of filenames to serve automatically when a directory is requested.

log_file_path.description: Path to the log file (only used if log_stdout is false).

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logged messages.

log_stdout.description: If true, log to standard output; otherwise, log to the specified log file.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

mime_mappings.description: Map of file extensions to custom MIME types (e.g., { 'webm': 'video/webm' }).

root_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory containing files to serve.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_enabled.description: If true, enable HTTPS using the provided certificate and key.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required if ssl_enabled is true).
